description: Dviračių takai is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija. The network of bicycle paths is located in the territory of Klaipeda city. Coverage: Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija. The portal shows the English title as "Bike roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klaipėdos miesto savivaldybės administracija. Its keywords include Dviratininkai, Dviračių Takai, Dviračiai, Infrastruktūra. The listing shows 3 download or service links in CSV, JSON. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
